title: content/world.yaml — world setup (geometry · grids · motion · sizes · senses · render)
description: The single tunable surface for world SHAPE/SIZE/SPEED values (docs/world-integration.md W1-W9). platform/config parses this into world.EnvConfig and the per-module Configs (climate.Config geometry, navmap.Config, the scent grid cellSize, fauna.Cadence + DT) and injects them via world.InstallEnv / world.InstallFauna. Numerics are UNTUNED placeholders (adjustable later; balance auto-tuning may sweep them). CROSS-FIELD INVARIANT (NOT expressible in JSON-Schema, enforced semantically by platform/config, D12): grids.scent_cell_size >= motion.max_speed * cadence.scent_spread (the scent cell-skip floor, W3). grids.navmap_cell_size SHOULD equal balance.yaml world.spatial_hash_cell. bounds MAY be overridden by a world-gen / scenario fixture (W1).

bounds.description: The finite rectangle the env grids span (W1). Agents/animals keep CONTINUOUS Pos (D11) and may stray outside; bounds clamp ONLY grid lookups (climate CellAt / navmap cell index). A fixture may override.

max.description: upper-right world corner; each axis MUST exceed min (semantic check)

grids.description: Auxiliary index cell sizes over the same continuous space (W2). One climate cell = (climate cell size / navmap_cell_size)^2 navmap cells; world owns the GridCell -> []navmap.Cell mapping.

navmap_cell_size.description: navmap cost-field cell edge; = balance.yaml world.spatial_hash_cell (keep in sync)

climate_grid_cols.description: coarse climate grid columns over bounds (-> climate.Config.GridCols)

climate_grid_rows.description: coarse climate grid rows over bounds (-> climate.Config.GridRows)

scent_cell_size.description: scent grid cell edge; MUST be >= motion.max_speed * cadence.scent_spread (cell-skip floor, W3 — semantic check)

motion.description: Base locomotion (world units per fauna DT; DT = 1 tick). Fauna base speeds; the species §6 Speed program modulates them. Agents move via MoveTo (not here).

fauna_dt.description: locomotion time-step magnitude for one tick (fauna.Snapshot.DT)

max_speed.description: fastest species; drives the scent_cell_size floor (W3)

cadence.description: Env-phase step intervals in ticks (world drives via tick % N, never wall-clock, D12).

climate_step.description: climate.Step cadence (e.g. 60 = 1 game-hour); wind shares it

scent_spread.description: Ns — scent diffusion bulk pass (drives scent_cell_size floor)

fauna_wake_cooldown.description: ticks an animal stays ACTIVE after a predator-scent wake

disengage_range_factor.description: combat disengage range factor multiplied by scent_cell_size

vital_regen_per_tick.description: combat vital regeneration rate per tick

vital_cap_damage_fraction.description: fraction of exchange damage applied as vital-cap scar

sizes.description: Representative entity sizes (per-species values ultimately live in objects.yaml; these are starting defaults + the render baseline). Animals are POINTS (W6): fauna 'size' is a §6 ATTRIBUTE, NOT a collision radius. Flora has real Length/Width morphology.

flora.description: Per-kind {length (height), width (canopy)} in world units (open kind keys).

fauna.description: Per-kind 'size' attribute (open kind keys); NOT a collision radius.

resource.description: Per-kind visual / interaction footprint radius, world units (open kind keys).

senses.description: Default fauna sense radii (per-species -> objects.yaml fauna.senses later). fov_arc = the HALF-angle (radians) of the forward sight cone (Heading ± fov_arc), F44.

render.description: Frontend display hints for the SSE WorldFrame consumer. God-view fields (real_stats) are NEVER sent over SSE.

smell_radius.description: scent-grid read radius (grid cellSize ∝ this, F32)

fov_arc.description: HALF-angle of the forward sight cone, radians (π = full 360° FOV)
